s0401.literal: On xinmao day, thirty men of the Shaanxi Mongol army campaigning in Yunnan were each granted six ingots of notes.
s0401.idiomatic: On xinmao day, 30 men of the Shaanxi Mongol army campaigning in Yunnan were each granted 6 ingots of notes.

s0402.literal: Supervising censors Dorolatai and Wang Wenruo said: "The Northern Pacification Branch Secretariat is the place where Taizu first established the foundation. Under Wuzong, Grand Preceptor Yuechicha'er was right chancellor and Grand Mentor Darqan was left chancellor; they secured the borderlands, and the court then had no worry of looking northward.
s0402.idiomatic: Supervising censors Dorolatai and Wang Wenruo said: "The Northern Pacification Branch Secretariat is where Taizu first established the foundation. Under Wuzong, Grand Preceptor Yuechicha'er was right chancellor and Grand Mentor Darqan was left chancellor; they secured the borderlands, and the court then had no worry of looking northward.

s0403.literal: Now that the Son of Heaven holds sway, yet Habartu has been appointed grand councillor — the man has no reputation for uprightness, bears a name for vulgarity, and is utterly ignorant of money, grain, armor, and troops; how can he proclaim and spread the imperial plan and assist in state affairs?
s0403.idiomatic: Now that the Son of Heaven holds sway, yet Habartu has been appointed grand councillor — the man has no reputation for uprightness, bears a name for vulgarity, and is utterly ignorant of money, grain, armor, and troops; how can he proclaim and spread the imperial plan and assist in state affairs?

s0404.literal: Moreover, with men such as Yuechicha'er placed before and this man succeeding after, worthy and unworthy surely need no debate to be clear; by right he should be dismissed.
s0404.idiomatic: Moreover, with men such as Yuechicha'er placed before and this man succeeding after, worthy and unworthy surely need no debate to be clear; by right he should be dismissed.

s0406.literal: On guisi day a white rainbow pierced the sun.
s0406.idiomatic: On guisi day a white rainbow pierced the sun.

s0407.literal: The Lu-chuan Route Military-Civil Metropolitan Commission was established; the metropolitan commission at Qara Khoja was also re-established.
s0407.idiomatic: The Lu-chuan Route Military-Civil Metropolitan Commission was established; the metropolitan commission at Qara Khoja was also re-established.

s0408.literal: On jiawu day Mars violated the Ghost Lodging accumulated corpse pneuma.
s0408.idiomatic: On jiawu day Mars violated the Ghost Lodging accumulated corpse pneuma.

s0409.literal: Alu, son of Prince of Wei Amuqa, was enfeoffed Western Pacification Prince.
s0409.idiomatic: Alu, son of Prince of Wei Amuqa, was enfeoffed Western Pacification Prince.

s0410.literal: On yiwei day, because of Start of Winter, the Five Blessings Ten Spirits and Supreme One Perfect Lord were sacrificed to.
s0410.idiomatic: On yiwei day, because of Start of Winter, the Five Blessings Ten Spirits and Supreme One Perfect Lord were sacrificed to.

s0411.literal: Censorate officials impeached: "Former central secretariat grand councillor Susu, presumptuously occupying the highest post, exclusively indulged in greed and licentiousness; twice he was caned one hundred seven strokes; exile was just being deliberated when fortunately he received imperial grace and was merely transferred to Huguang by measure.
s0411.idiomatic: Censorate officials impeached: "Former central secretariat grand councillor Susu, presumptuously occupying the highest post, exclusively indulged in greed and licentiousness; twice he was caned 107 strokes; exile was just being deliberated when fortunately he received imperial grace and was merely transferred to Huguang by measure.

s0412.literal: He does not again fear the law and keep himself in order, but instead takes a wife and marries a concubine, wantonly defiling in countless ways.
s0412.idiomatic: He does not again fear the law and keep himself in order, but instead takes a wife and marries a concubine, wantonly defiling in countless ways.

s0413.literal: Moreover Huguang is a place where troops are heavily garrisoned — how is it fitting that he dwell there?
s0413.idiomatic: Moreover Huguang is a place where troops are heavily garrisoned — how is it fitting that he dwell there?

s0414.literal: We beg to banish him to a remote borderland to show utmost fairness."
s0414.idiomatic: We beg to banish him to a remote borderland to show utmost fairness."

s0415.literal: An edict permanently exiled him to Leizhou; Huguang Branch Secretariat dispatched men to escort him there in shackles.
s0415.idiomatic: An edict permanently exiled him to Leizhou; Huguang Branch Secretariat dispatched men to escort him there in shackles.

s0416.literal: On bingshen day, because the Grand Elder Princess of Lu State's residence was not yet finished, ten thousand ingots of notes were again granted; central secretariat grand councillor Yiliechi was ordered to oversee the labor.
s0416.idiomatic: On bingshen day, because the Grand Elder Princess of Lu State's residence was not yet finished, 10,000 ingots of notes were again granted; central secretariat grand councillor Yiliechi was ordered to oversee the labor.

s0417.literal: On jihai day, because the Kuizhang Pavilion was compiling the 《Jingshi Dadian》, the secretariat, privy council, and censorate and other offices were ordered to host banquets in succession for their officials.
s0417.idiomatic: On jihai day, because the Kuizhang Pavilion was compiling the 《Jingshi Dadian》, the secretariat, privy council, and censorate and other offices were ordered to host banquets in succession for their officials.

s0418.literal: Five hundred qing of official fields in Pingjiang and other places were granted to the Grand Elder Princess of Lu State.
s0418.idiomatic: 500 qing of official fields in Pingjiang and other places were granted to the Grand Elder Princess of Lu State.

s0419.literal: Edict: "Among the people, those not of their native custom who dare take a younger brother's wife as widow or a son a secondary mother — shall be punished as criminals."
s0419.idiomatic: Edict: "Among the people, those not of their native custom who dare take a younger brother's wife as widow or a son a secondary mother — shall be punished as criminals."

s0420.literal: On renyin day the property and goods of guard household troops of the various guards were verified.
s0420.idiomatic: On renyin day the property and goods of guard household troops of the various guards were verified.

s0421.literal: Ten thousand ingots of notes were granted to the Grand Elder Princess of Lu State; Yan Temür was ordered to go to her residence and deliver them.
s0421.idiomatic: 10,000 ingots of notes were granted to the Grand Elder Princess of Lu State; Yan Temür was ordered to go to her residence and deliver them.

s0422.literal: On bingwu day western monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites at the Great Brightness Hall.
s0422.idiomatic: On bingwu day western monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites at the Great Brightness Hall.

s0423.literal: Shi Weiliang again begged to resign office and return home to support his parents; his request was granted, and two hundred ingots of notes were still granted him.
s0423.idiomatic: Shi Weiliang again begged to resign office and return home to support his parents; his request was granted, and 200 ingots of notes were still granted him.

s0424.literal: On dingwei day central secretariat associate administrator Zhang Youliang was made left vice chancellor; privy council administrator Tabudai was made Shaanxi Branch Secretariat censor-in-chief.
s0424.idiomatic: On dingwei day central secretariat associate administrator Zhang Youliang was made left vice chancellor; privy council administrator Tabudai was made Shaanxi Branch Secretariat censor-in-chief.

s0425.literal: Thirty-two relays including Tierigan and Mulin — from summer and autumn no rain; livestock mostly died and the people were severely famished — Northern Pacification Branch Secretariat men were ordered to relieve each with two shi of grain.
s0425.idiomatic: 32 relays including Tierigan and Mulin — from summer and autumn no rain; livestock mostly died and the people were severely famished — Northern Pacification Branch Secretariat men were ordered to relieve each with 2 shi of grain.

s0426.literal: At the beginning of Zhizhi, White Cloud Sect fields were given to Shou'an Mountain Monastery as perpetual property; at this time its monk Shen Mingqi spoke on the matter, and an instruction ordered the central secretariat to correct it.
s0426.idiomatic: At the beginning of Zhizhi, White Cloud Sect fields were given to Shou'an Mountain Monastery as perpetual property; at this time its monk Shen Mingqi spoke on the matter, and an instruction ordered the central secretariat to correct it.

s0427.literal: Relevant offices were edicted to repair the southern suburb fasting palace.
s0427.idiomatic: Relevant offices were edicted to repair the southern suburb fasting palace.

s0428.literal: Shuidada Route of Liaoyang Branch Secretariat — since last summer continuous rain, the Heilong and Songwa two rivers overflowed, and the people had no fish for food.
s0428.idiomatic: Shuidada Route of Liaoyang Branch Secretariat — since last summer continuous rain, the Heilong and Songwa two rivers overflowed, and the people had no fish for food.

s0429.literal: At this time, Melursun's fifteen-dog relay — many dogs starved to death; two months' relief grain was given; for dead dogs, notes were given to make up purchases in the market.
s0429.idiomatic: At this time, Melursun's fifteen-dog relay — many dogs starved to death; 2 months' relief grain was given; for dead dogs, notes were given to make up purchases in the market.

s0430.literal: Shi Mo of Wanhu Tegelibuqhua's mother in Chenzhou for recorded integrity, and Chen Bida of Longxi County, Zhangzhou, for filial conduct — both had their gates honored.
s0430.idiomatic: Shi Mo of Wanhu Tegelibuqhua's mother in Chenzhou for recorded integrity, and Chen Bida of Longxi County, Zhangzhou, for filial conduct — both had their gates honored.

s0431.literal: Tenth month of winter, wushen new moon — an imperial-seal edict was sent down admonishing the Duke Who Extends Sagacity to revere and serve Confucius temple affairs.
s0431.idiomatic: Tenth month of winter, wushen new moon — an imperial-seal edict was sent down admonishing the Duke Who Extends Sagacity to revere and serve Confucius temple affairs.

s0432.literal: A three-bead tiger tally was granted to Huguang Branch Secretariat associate administrator Hudu Sha of Yunnan.
s0432.idiomatic: A 3-bead tiger tally was granted to Huguang Branch Secretariat associate administrator Hudu Sha of Yunnan.

s0433.literal: On xinhai day Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to give Prince Yundu Temür one hundred bolts of currency cloth to reward officers and soldiers who had merit in capturing Yao bandits.
s0433.idiomatic: On xinhai day Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to give Prince Yundu Temür 100 bolts of currency cloth to reward officers and soldiers who had merit in capturing Yao bandits.

s0434.literal: On renzi day princes and great ministers again requested establishing the Yan prince as crown prince; the Emperor said: "What you say is indeed correct.
s0434.idiomatic: On renzi day princes and great ministers again requested establishing the Yan prince as crown prince; the Emperor said: "What you say is indeed correct.

s0435.literal: But the Yan prince is still young; I fear his understanding and deliberation are not yet broad and he cannot bear the burden — to deliberate later is not too late."
s0435.idiomatic: But the Yan prince is still young; I fear his understanding and deliberation are not yet broad and he cannot bear the burden — to deliberate later is not too late."

s0436.literal: The Loyal and Faithful Imperial Guard Command wanhu camp was established north of Dadu; one hundred thirty-odd qing of civilian fields in the city market were granted it.
s0436.idiomatic: The Loyal and Faithful Imperial Guard Command wanhu camp was established north of Dadu; 130-odd qing of civilian fields in the city market were granted it.

s0437.literal: On wuwu day purification was performed at the Great Brightness Hall.
s0437.idiomatic: On wuwu day purification was performed at the Great Brightness Hall.

s0438.literal: On jiwei day secondary offering officer central secretariat right chancellor Yan Temür and final offering officer Timur Buqa led the various officiants to announce at the temple, requesting Taizu Emperor as co-attendant at the southern suburb.
s0438.idiomatic: On jiwei day secondary offering officer central secretariat right chancellor Yan Temür and final offering officer Timur Buqa led the various officiants to announce at the temple, requesting Taizu Emperor as co-attendant at the southern suburb.

s0439.literal: On gengshen day the Emperor moved out to the suburban palace.
s0439.idiomatic: On gengshen day the Emperor moved out to the suburban palace.

s0440.literal: On xinyou day the Emperor wore great fur robe and twelve-symbol regalia and sacrificed to Supreme Heaven God at the southern suburb, with Taizu Emperor as co-attendant; when the rite was completed, that day the great procession returned to the palace.
s0440.idiomatic: On xinyou day the Emperor wore great fur robe and twelve-symbol regalia and sacrificed to Supreme Heaven God at the southern suburb, with Taizu Emperor as co-attendant; when the rite was completed, that day the great procession returned to the palace.

s0441.literal: On jiazi day, because Fengyuan relay horses were lean and died, Shaanxi Branch Secretariat was ordered to give three thousand ingots of notes to make up purchases in the market.
s0441.idiomatic: On jiazi day, because Fengyuan relay horses were lean and died, Shaanxi Branch Secretariat was ordered to give 3,000 ingots of notes to make up purchases in the market.

s0442.literal: Three thousand households of herders dwelling at Muna Qoshiyun and five thousand households of the falconry bureau dwelling along the Yellow River — each was given two months' relief grain.
s0442.idiomatic: 3,000 households of herders dwelling at Muna Qoshiyun and 5,000 households of the falconry bureau dwelling along the Yellow River — each was given 2 months' relief grain.

s0443.literal: On yichou day Guangxi Yao bandits raided Heng Prefecture and Yongchun County; Guangxi Marshal's Office was edicted to lead troops to capture them.
s0443.idiomatic: On yichou day Guangxi Yao bandits raided Heng Prefecture and Yongchun County; Guangxi Marshal's Office was edicted to lead troops to capture them.

s0444.literal: Privy council officials said: "Each year when the great procession visits Shangdu, one thousand five hundred guard soldiers of each guard are mobilized as escort; further, fifteen thousand Han troops of the various guards are mobilized to encamp behind the mountains, and three thousand Mongol troops encamp at Guanshan to guard passes and bridges.
s0444.idiomatic: Privy council officials said: "Each year when the great procession visits Shangdu, 1,500 guard soldiers of each guard are mobilized as escort; further, 15,000 Han troops of the various guards are mobilized to encamp behind the mountains, and 3,000 Mongol troops encamp at Guanshan to guard passes and bridges.

s0445.literal: We beg to mobilize according to the former numbers, to await next year."
s0445.idiomatic: We beg to mobilize according to the former numbers, to await next year."

s0447.literal: On xinwei day Wumeng Route native official Azhao submitted and sent his interpreter Alei and others to present tribute goods.
s0447.idiomatic: On xinwei day Wumeng Route native official Azhao submitted and sent his interpreter Alei and others to present tribute goods.

s0448.literal: On renshen day censorate officials said: "Civil and military officials within and without who let their family members receive bribes — though it violates right conduct in their name, punishment is only the fifty-seven-stroke rule and removal from office.
s0448.idiomatic: On renshen day censorate officials said: "Civil and military officials within and without who let their family members receive bribes — though it violates right conduct in their name, punishment is only the 57-stroke rule and removal from office.

s0449.literal: Now corrupt men increasingly offend the law by this; we request that according to the Twelve Chapters, guilt be determined by the amount of bribes."
s0449.idiomatic: Now corrupt men increasingly offend the law by this; we request that according to the Twelve Chapters, guilt be determined by the amount of bribes."

s0451.literal: On jiaxu day edict: "Palace encampment offices of successive reigns — in all documents they may not address the empress; they may only address a certain lady below rank.
s0451.idiomatic: On jiaxu day edict: "Palace encampment offices of successive reigns — in all documents they may not address the empress; they may only address a certain lady below rank.

s0452.literal: All officials they employ shall be proposed and reported by the central secretariat."
s0452.idiomatic: All officials they employ shall be proposed and reported by the central secretariat."

s0453.literal: On yihai day the Hawk-catching Falconry Metropolitan Commission was changed to the Benevolent Bliss Capital Metropolitan Commission.
s0453.idiomatic: On yihai day the Hawk-catching Falconry Metropolitan Commission was changed to the Benevolent Bliss Capital Metropolitan Commission.

s0454.literal: Privy council administrator Sadun and Xuanhui commissioner Tangqishi were both granted the Darqan title.
s0454.idiomatic: Privy council administrator Sadun and Xuanhui commissioner Tangqishi were both granted the Darqan title.

s0455.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "In the recent campaign against Yunnan, two hundred thousand ingots of notes were already given as military supplies; the outlay is now exhausted, and Western Pacification Martial Pacification Prince Shuosiban together with branch secretariat and mobile privy council again request notes in the former amount.
s0455.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "In the recent campaign against Yunnan, 200,000 ingots of notes were already given as military supplies; the outlay is now exhausted, and Western Pacification Martial Pacification Prince Shuosiban together with branch secretariat and mobile privy council again request notes in the former amount.

s0456.literal: We deliberated: at the time when advance attack is imminent, it is fitting to grant as requested."
s0456.idiomatic: We deliberated: at the time when advance attack is imminent, it is fitting to grant as requested."

s0458.literal: The temple plaque of Boyi and Shuqi was granted the title Sagely Purity; in spring and autumn of each year they are sacrificed to with the lesser victim.
s0458.idiomatic: The temple plaque of Boyi and Shuqi was granted the title Sagely Purity; in spring and autumn of each year they are sacrificed to with the lesser victim.

s0459.literal: Envoys were dispatched to urge Sichuan and Yunnan branch secretariat troops to advance in attack.
s0459.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to urge Sichuan and Yunnan branch secretariat troops to advance in attack.

s0460.literal: Thereupon Sichuan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Tacho led troops by Yongning; left vice chancellor Boluo led troops by Qingshan and Mangbu advancing together; troops were arrayed at Zhou'ni Post Station and fought Luoyu and others, killing over three hundred barbarian troops.
s0460.idiomatic: Thereupon Sichuan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Tacho led troops by Yongning; left vice chancellor Boluo led troops by Qingshan and Mangbu advancing together; troops were arrayed at Zhou'ni Post Station and fought Luoyu and others, killing over 300 barbarian troops.

s0461.literal: Luoyu's forces were routed; they immediately seized his passes and barriers to guide Shunyuan troops.
s0461.idiomatic: Luoyu's forces were routed; they immediately seized his passes and barriers to guide Shunyuan troops.

s0462.literal: At that time Yunnan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Qizhu and others all failed to arrive by the deadline.
s0462.idiomatic: At that time Yunnan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Qizhu and others all failed to arrive by the deadline.

s0463.literal: Eleventh month, on gengchen day the central secretariat was ordered to sell relief grain of one hundred thousand shi to aid the capital's poor.
s0463.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on gengchen day the central secretariat was ordered to sell relief grain of 100,000 shi to aid the capital's poor.

s0464.literal: On xinsi day censorate officials said: "Shaanxi Branch Secretariat left vice chancellor Qielie, having accepted from a man one bondservant and a parrot — we request judgment according to law."
s0464.idiomatic: On xinsi day censorate officials said: "Shaanxi Branch Secretariat left vice chancellor Qielie, having accepted from a man 1 bondservant and a parrot — we request judgment according to law."

s0465.literal: An edict said: "Having reached chancellor rank and eating the state's thick salary, yet still accepting living persons from men — by reason he ought to be guilty.
s0465.idiomatic: An edict said: "Having reached chancellor rank and eating the state's thick salary, yet still accepting living persons from men — by reason he ought to be guilty.

s0466.literal: As for a parrot, a trifling thing — to treat this as bribery judgment would err on excessive severity; let the heavier matter determine guilt.
s0466.idiomatic: As for a parrot, a trifling thing — to treat this as bribery judgment would err on excessive severity; let the heavier matter determine guilt.

s0467.literal: Hereafter for all who present birds, do not treat as bribes; establish this as regulation."
s0467.idiomatic: Hereafter for all who present birds, do not treat as bribes; establish this as regulation."

s0468.literal: On guimao day grain of twenty thousand shi was relieved to fifteen thousand seven hundred qielian households of the various palace encampments wintering along the Luan River at Shangdu.
s0468.idiomatic: On guimao day grain of 20,000 shi was relieved to 15,700 qielian households of the various palace encampments wintering along the Luan River at Shangdu.

s0469.literal: On jiashen day Mars withdrew after violating the Ghost Lodging.
s0469.idiomatic: On jiashen day Mars withdrew after violating the Ghost Lodging.

s0470.literal: The Imperial Preceptor was ordered to lead western monks in performing Buddhist rites — eight places within and without in total — beginning this day and ending at year's end.
s0470.idiomatic: The Imperial Preceptor was ordered to lead western monks in performing Buddhist rites — 8 places within and without in total — beginning this day and ending at year's end.

s0471.literal: On bingxu day Venus violated the Rampart Formation.
s0471.idiomatic: On bingxu day Venus violated the Rampart Formation.

s0472.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "During the Zhiyuan period, Anfeng, Anqing, Luzhou and other routes had one thousand four hundred thirty-six households not yet attached to registers; Shizu ordered their yearly tax levies granted to Chuangwu'er.
s0472.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "During the Zhiyuan period, Anfeng, Anqing, Luzhou and other routes had 1,436 households not yet attached to registers; Shizu ordered their yearly tax levies granted to Chuangwu'er.

s0473.literal: Later they were attached to registers; the yearly levies submitted all entered government coffers, and separately the Wanyi Treasury yearly gave two hundred ingots of notes.
s0473.idiomatic: Later they were attached to registers; the yearly levies submitted all entered government coffers, and separately the Wanyi Treasury yearly gave 200 ingots of notes.

s0474.literal: Now we beg to stop the notes granted and again restore those households as grant to Chuangwu'er's son Yan Temür."
s0474.idiomatic: Now we beg to stop the notes granted and again restore those households as grant to Chuangwu'er's son Yan Temür."

s0476.literal: Luoluo Sajiabo of Luolosi, Ada of Wusa, and others jointly led fifteen thousand barbarians to attack Jianchang; Yueli Temür and others led troops in pursuit to battle below Mount Muto, defeated them, and beheaded over five hundred heads.
s0476.idiomatic: Luoluo Sajiabo of Luolosi, Ada of Wusa, and others jointly led 15,000 barbarians to attack Jianchang; Yueli Temür and others led troops in pursuit to battle below Mount Muto, defeated them, and beheaded over 500 heads.

s0477.literal: Sixty-three households of Hui and Deng Uighur people harmed by western troops — each household was given fifteen ingots of notes and two shi of rice;
s0477.idiomatic: 63 households of Hui and Deng Uighur people harmed by western troops — each household was given 15 ingots of notes and 2 shi of rice;

s0478.literal: Five hundred seventy-seven households plundered by western troops — each household was given five ingots of notes and two shi of rice.
s0478.idiomatic: 577 households plundered by western troops — each household was given 5 ingots of notes and 2 shi of rice.

s0479.literal: Guangxi surveillance commission said: "In the present campaign against rebellious Yao, branch secretariat officials leading twenty thousand troops are all encamped at Jingjiang, delaying and not advancing — days drag on for long, and I fear the opportunity will be lost."
s0479.idiomatic: Guangxi surveillance commission said: "In the present campaign against rebellious Yao, branch secretariat officials leading 20,000 troops are all encamped at Jingjiang, delaying and not advancing — days drag on for long, and I fear the opportunity will be lost."

s0480.literal: An edict dispatched envoys to urge them.
s0480.idiomatic: An edict dispatched envoys to urge them.

s0481.literal: Privy council administrator Yanbulin requested that according to the old system falconry bureau fodder grain be fully supplied so they would not suffer want.
s0481.idiomatic: Privy council administrator Yanbulin requested that according to the old system falconry bureau fodder grain be fully supplied so they would not suffer want.

s0482.literal: The Emperor said: "State expenditures all come from what the common people supply — expenditures should be measured against income; how could We, for the falconry bureau's loss, heavily burden Our people?"
s0482.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "State expenditures all come from what the common people supply — expenditures should be measured against income; how could We, for the falconry bureau's loss, heavily burden Our people?"

s0484.literal: On xinmao day Kuokuotai was made privy council administrator.
s0484.idiomatic: On xinmao day Kuokuotai was made privy council administrator.

s0485.literal: Three thousand ingots of Shandong salt duty notes were given to relieve famine victims in Jiyin and other counties of Caozhou.
s0485.idiomatic: 3,000 ingots of Shandong salt duty notes were given to relieve famine victims in Jiyin and other counties of Caozhou.

s0486.literal: On guisi day the rent and tax yielded by one thousand qing of Tianyuan Yansheng Monastery fields in Linjiang and Ji'an two routes was made subordinate to the Supreme Blessings Sacrificial Court.
s0486.idiomatic: On guisi day the rent and tax yielded by 1,000 qing of Tianyuan Yansheng Monastery fields in Linjiang and Ji'an 2 routes was made subordinate to the Supreme Blessings Sacrificial Court.

s0487.literal: On wuxu day the Hawk-catching Falconry Safflower Metropolitan Commission was established in Liaoyang Branch Secretariat, rank 4b.
s0487.idiomatic: On wuxu day the Hawk-catching Falconry Safflower Metropolitan Commission was established in Liaoyang Branch Secretariat, rank 4b.

s0488.literal: On xinchou day the land and grain tax of voluntarily declared fields among the people of Henan Branch Secretariat was levied; in places not accessible by boat transport, submission in notes was permitted.
s0488.idiomatic: On xinchou day the land and grain tax of voluntarily declared fields among the people of Henan Branch Secretariat was levied; in places not accessible by boat transport, submission in notes was permitted.

s0489.literal: Shaanxi Branch Secretariat was ordered to relieve two months' grain to Mongol colony field guard soldiers at Hezhou.
s0489.idiomatic: Shaanxi Branch Secretariat was ordered to relieve 2 months' grain to Mongol colony field guard soldiers at Hezhou.

s0490.literal: On jiachen day the Directorate of Astronomy was ordered to observe the comet.
s0490.idiomatic: On jiachen day the Directorate of Astronomy was ordered to observe the comet.

s0491.literal: On bingwu day Prince of En Anhui, for beating and injuring inspector Zhang Gong, was caned fifty-seven strokes and banished back to Prince of Guangning's division for military service.
s0491.idiomatic: On bingwu day Prince of En Anhui, for beating and injuring inspector Zhang Gong, was caned 57 strokes and banished back to Prince of Guangning's division for military service.

s0492.literal: Twelfth month, wushen day — Bayan and others were dispatched because the Yan prince Alaqtenashiri was about to be established as crown prince to announce sacrifices at the suburban altar and temples.
s0492.idiomatic: Twelfth month, wushen day — Bayan and others were dispatched because the Yan prince Alaqtenashiri was about to be established as crown prince to announce sacrifices at the suburban altar and temples.

s0493.literal: On jiwei day Dong Zhongshu was granted associate sacrifice at the Confucius temple, ranking below the Seventy Disciples.
s0493.idiomatic: On jiwei day Dong Zhongshu was granted associate sacrifice at the Confucius temple, ranking below the Seventy Disciples.

s0494.literal: National University students who accumulated full credits and grades — secretariat, censorate, Imperial Academy, and Kuizhang Pavilion officials jointly examined them; those who passed were tested for office by grade; those who failed returned to study.
s0494.idiomatic: National University students who accumulated full credits and grades — secretariat, censorate, Imperial Academy, and Kuizhang Pavilion officials jointly examined them; those who passed were tested for office by grade; those who failed returned to study.

s0495.literal: One hundred thousand shi of millet, and fifteen thousand shi each of rice and beans, were given to horse-breeding official families of Hebei routes; the Loyal and Faithful Imperial Guard Alan colony fields were given cattle, seed, and farm implements.
s0495.idiomatic: 100,000 shi of millet, and 15,000 shi each of rice and beans, were given to horse-breeding official families of Hebei routes; the Loyal and Faithful Imperial Guard Alan colony fields were given cattle, seed, and farm implements.

s0496.literal: On xinhai day the Yan prince Alaqtenashiri was established as crown prince; proclaimed throughout the realm.
s0496.idiomatic: On xinhai day the Yan prince Alaqtenashiri was established as crown prince; proclaimed throughout the realm.

s0497.literal: On jiayin day western route soldiers dwelling at Yongping, Luanzhou, Fengyun, and Yutian — each man was given three ingots of notes, two bolts of cloth, and two months' grain.
s0497.idiomatic: On jiayin day western route soldiers dwelling at Yongping, Luanzhou, Fengyun, and Yutian — each man was given 3 ingots of notes, 2 bolts of cloth, and 2 months' grain.

s0498.literal: Supervising censors said: "Formerly Prince of Yu, having the Yan residence, was properly established in the heir's position; Shizu selected aged and venerable old ministers such as Wang Yong, Yao Sui, Xiao Huan, and others as his tutor, protector, and guests.
s0498.idiomatic: Supervising censors said: "Formerly Prince of Yu, having the Yan residence, was properly established in the heir's position; Shizu selected aged and venerable old ministers such as Wang Yong, Yao Sui, Xiao Huan, and others as his tutor, protector, and guests.

s0499.literal: Now the crown prince is benevolent, filial, intelligent, and perceptive, endowed by nature; it is truly fitting to carefully select those of virtue and seniority, of pure learning and conduct, and place them at his left and right to nurture rectitude — this is truly the fortune of the altars of state and the living people."
s0499.idiomatic: Now the crown prince is benevolent, filial, intelligent, and perceptive, endowed by nature; it is truly fitting to carefully select those of virtue and seniority, of pure learning and conduct, and place them at his left and right to nurture rectitude — this is truly the fortune of the altars of state and the living people."

s0500.literal: The Emperor praised and adopted their words.
